mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly increases the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, reducing present valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the direction of the relationship flips to positive in more than 30% of the sample.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the past 3 months signals an emerging economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5% and the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 295, the combination signals a high risk of stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 3.5 and CPIAUCSL > 295, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 290), a higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly increases the discount rate for equity valuations, reducing present valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the regime defined by FEDFUNDS > 3.5 and CPIAUCSL > 290, the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03, or the relationship is positive in more than 30% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 690,000 million dollars over the past 3 months signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 690000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO level and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the direction of the relationship flips to negative in more than 30% of the sample.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 155,000 thousand persons over the past 3 months signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 155000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) above 1,400,000 units signals strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
